# performance.c drives its message pump with a CONDITION_VARIABLE.
remove_definitions(-D_WIN32_WINNT=0x502 -DWINVER=0x502)
add_definitions(
    -D__WINESRC__
    -D__ROS_LONG64__
    -D_WIN32_WINNT=0x600
    -DWINVER=0x600)

include_directories(${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/../dmusic)

spec2def(dmime.dll dmime.spec)

add_idl_reg_objects(dmime registry dmime.idl)

# dmime.dll is C, and cargo compiles and links it:
# sdk/lib/rust/dmime-cargo (reactos-link, generated by tools/cargo_cell_gen.py).
# The C still compiled, in an OBJECT library whose compile the cargo link replays.
# How cmake compiled the target's sources, now on the OBJECT libraries.
# Generated inputs those compiles read, ordered before them.
add_library(dmime_shims OBJECT audiopath.c dmime_main.c graph.c lyricstrack.c markertrack.c midi.c paramcontroltrack.c performance.c segment.c segmentstate.c segtriggertrack.c seqtrack.c sysextrack.c tempotrack.c timesigtrack.c wavetrack.c ${REACTOS_SOURCE_DIR}/dll/directx/wine/dmusic/band.c ${REACTOS_SOURCE_DIR}/dll/directx/wine/dmusic/dmobject.c ${REACTOS_SOURCE_DIR}/dll/directx/wine/dmusic/wave.c)
target_link_libraries(dmime_shims PRIVATE wine wine_dll_register wine_dll_canunload dxguid uuid oldnames libdsound libole32 libuser32 libadvapi32 libkernel32_vista libmsvcrt libkernel32 libntdll)
set_wine_module(dmime_shims)
add_dependencies(dmime_shims wineheaders)
set(DMIME_REUSED
    ${CMAKE_BINARY_DIR}/dll/directx/wine/dmime/dmime_r.o)
add_cargo_module(dmime dmime-cargo dmime.dll
    KIND win32dll
    DESTINATION reactos/system32
    EXTRA_DEPENDS dmime_shims psdk dmime_r ${DMIME_REUSED} uuid_sources)
